fact: The paper states Lesotho's automated CRVS launched in 2013 and was connected to hospitals from 2015, the Kobo birth e-notification tablet app was piloted in three districts from 2021 and launched in August 2023 but not rolled out beyond them, and birth registration completeness was 66.1% in 2022.
title: The Impact of Digitalization on Birth Registration Completeness in Lesotho: A Mixed-Methods Study
publisher: National Identity and Civil Registry, Lesotho (2026 CRVS Research Forum)
